sources.title: Government of the Virgin Islands, Office of the Deputy Governor, Cabinet Approves 2026 Public Holidays (31 October 2025)
sources.said: Cabinet has approved the following public holidays for 2026, acting in accordance with Section 5 of the Public Holidays Act (Cap 199), as amended. Tuesday 30th June, 2026 will be one-off public holiday for the Commemoration of the 250th Anniversary of Freedom at Nottingham Estate, Long Look. Thursday 1st January – New Year’s Day; Monday 9th March – The Anniversary of the Birth of Hamilton Lavity Stoutt (In lieu of Friday, 6th March); Friday 3rd April – Good Friday; Monday 6th April – Easter Monday; Monday 25th May – Whit Monday; Friday 12th June – Sovereign’s Birthday; Tuesday, 30th June - Commemoration of the 250th Anniversary of Freedom at Nottingham Estate, Long Look; Monday 6th July – Virgin Islands Day; Monday 3rd August – Emancipation Monday; Tuesday 4th August – Emancipation Tuesday; Wednesday 5th August – Emancipation Wednesday; Monday 19th October – Heroes and Foreparents Day; Monday 23rd November – Commemoration of the Great March of 1949 and the Restoration of the Legislative Council; Friday 25th December – Christmas Day; Monday 28th December – Boxing Day (In lieu of Saturday 26th December).
